responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module specifies the exception-tree construction API implemented by m2except.cc. It exposes initialization of the EH runtime bindings and the builders for throw expressions, try blocks, and catch handlers, giving Modula-2-side code a foreign interface to GCC’s generic exception representation.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2except group: it presents the exception-building entry points as FOR "C" procedures for Modula-2 clients, unlike m2except.h's C/C++ prototypes and m2except.cc's actual EH lowering implementation.
